[EN] Always After Me Lucky Charms
[ES] Siempre Tras Mis Amuletos de la Suerte
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use this onslaught charm while standing next to a campfire.
[ES] Usa este amuleto de asalto mientras estás de pie junto a una fogata.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You can use up to three charms at once.
[ES] Puedes usar hasta tres amuletos a la vez.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Use an onslaught charm. To receive benefits, wait until your Stamina is 100%.
[ES] Usa un amuleto de asalto. Para recibir sus beneficios, espera a que tu Stamina esté al 100%.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You have successfully used the onslaught charm!
[ES] ¡Has usado con éxito el amuleto de asalto!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "For the federation!"
[ES] "¡Por la federación!"
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Successfully used charm. Talk to Milene for additional information.
[ES] Amuleto usado con éxito. Habla con Milene para obtener más información.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
